kind: polyester double braid (sheets, halyards, control lines); 16-carrier cover for dock and mooring lines

where.live_lines: M_RigRope (scripts/import_boat_detail.py ROPE_CODE) on FRigLine tubes and the hero J/22's coiled tails (BoatModelVisuals.cpp)
where.kit_parts: BOAT_CODE surf == 9 in scripts/make_materials.py (rope on kit parts and fleet models)
where.hero_bake: Inputs/j22-hero/j22_rope.py rope_material (stills and the J/22 hero bake)

boats.J/22: jib sheets 3/8 in (9.5 mm), mainsheet 3/8 in, halyards 5/16 in, vang and cunningham 1/4 in, backstay bridle, dock lines 1/2 in (Braid16)

pattern.braid24_lay_mm: 5 x diameter per turn of a carrier (45 mm on 9 mm line)
pattern.pick_mm: measured from the L0 photos (Tools/texloop/refs/rope.json targets.pick_mm)
pattern.texel_rule: >= 4 texture px per mm at 0.3 m: a 1024 px tile over 45 x 28 mm gives 23 px/mm along, 36 px/mm round

level_notes.L0: new: bright white or saturated colour, crisp tight cover, slight sheen, no fuzz
level_notes.L1: a few months: cover a touch softer and duller, faint grey where it runs through cam cleats and fairleads
level_notes.L2: club boat, 6 yr: grey-beige, fuzzy cover (pilled fibres stand off), dark band where the cleat bites, colours faded
level_notes.L3: 30-year boat, kept: lines are replaced every few seasons, so mostly L1 rope; a slight sun fade on halyards that stay up
level_notes.L4: neglected: grey-green, stiff, heavy fuzz, mildew specks and black dirt in the weave, red and blue faded toward pink and slate

time_vs_dirt: Rope is consumable: care replaces it, so most of its look follows Dirt, not Time. Time only adds UV fade on lines that stay rigged (halyards).

replaces.M_RigRope: fixed Fade 0.4 and Dirt 0.5 on every boat (never set by the game), so a new boat's sheets look club-worn
replaces.BOAT_CODE: surf >= 9 shared rope/sailcloth/canvas dinginess (col*0.8 grey) and mildew; rope gets its own branch
replaces.hero_bake: style ropes.fade from wear and care, dirt from the deck grime

budget: Medium: no new maps (shader math). High: at most one extra 1024 mask shared by every rope (fuzz/pilling) inside the +8 MB texture-loop allowance
